_comment: Does not start in a mock session today: CautiousMacd rests its entry (STOP_LIMIT here, STOP without use_stop_limit) and the mock adapter carries market orders only, so the start is refused naming the mock. The startup-guard test uses this profile for its cold-start hook; it starts once the mock adapter rests orders.

deployment._comment: Do this profile's sessions form ONE deployment whose ledger rows join into one history? MANDATORY — there is no safe default. Declare true only on a profile you are actually deploying; the CLI can narrow it (--one-off) but never widen it.
